envelope.description: Add Darwin job and peer identity primitives

body.title: Add Darwin job and peer identity primitives
body.summary: Implement the narrow Darwin support for Unix peer PID and UID, process incarnation, read-only exit observation and verified per-user launch-job ownership. Package the platform-specific entry points and keep the Linux process broker unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Peer mismatch, reused PID, wrong launch domain and unverified job removal fail closed
Darwin observations work without a Mach task right and Linux packaging remains intact

tests.name: Compares peer identity and scopes job labels by installation root
Validates idle job evidence and refuses the wrong domain or relative program
Rejects a reused PID with a different start incarnation
Legacy exit observation rejects PID reuse, owner mismatch and timeout without invoking the Mach broker
Uses separate labels for test roots and rejects a foreign registered root
Legacy socket peer UID or PID differs from the registered process incarnation
Rejects a foreign peer PID or executable
Verifies recovery job registration against the pinned descriptor and argv
Observes exact exit of a disposable child with the read-only Darwin helper
